title: Care for Yourself
content:
And I just care for myself
These bitty streets done taught me not to ask you for help
Everyone got pain, how you deal is the issue
I hope that you find the strength to go pick up a tissue.
Why I talk down on myself?
I say a shitty poet like my pen don't propel
I know I'm not old, my mistakes is an issue
I just hope I'm not too arrogant to forgive you.
And I owe it to myself
To leave something concrete one day my children could tell
Living on the edge going past what I been through
Finding love in places that i never thought I'd get to

title: Demons and Angels
content:
I could think a million thoughts
Picture many different waves
It don't change the fact that sleeping feel like rolling in my grave
I'm sorry baby I'm not disciplined, I like chasing dames
I like chasing highs, youngboul I like running fades
Had to trim off all the fat, peeped them tryna steal my wave
Tryna draw my blood, they want clone me not the same
Gave up on a demon, subtly, trying to find change
But I'm clicked with demons and angels I can't act the same

content:
I seen OG twerking that’s how I know he off that tranq

Memories they sit so heavenly just let me think
Reminiscing bout my dead homies down the sink
I was just down Lehigh tryna get back to the F
I was just down Tackawana had to watch my step
Yeah ya boy in college but I still be round the jets
I like that the fiends ain’t judging like my every step
One day I can’t save em but yeah one day I could change em

One day I can keep my memories I’m tryna save em

title: One Day
content:
One day I got memories and one day I just don’t
One day I can keep the things I went through in my skull
One day I’ll be bold, but like right now? I’m just cold
One day I won’t have to worry if they think I’m old
One day Imma glide, imma take off, I’ll be fly
One day imma stop experiencing peace of mind 
One day I’ll be fine, and yeah one day we all die
Everything happen in one day, now I’m crying!

title: Day & Night
content:
I don’t cry tears in the daytime
Because memories come in the night
And my brothers who no longer with me
Come for visits and leave me with plights
If I push you away it’s not personal
I just don’t want ugly to bleed through
Because if you with me in the night time
Then my demons might visit you too
If my poetry truly is shitty
Then I pray to my God in the air
Help me keep all these demons in my head
Because I don’t want you to feel pain

title: Mr. Make It Happen
content:
They keep asking why I’m rapping
I was Mr.Make It Happen
I’m still Mr.Make It Happen
Got the Midas touch I’m feeling gold
You don’t know my backend 
Or my story what I’m cracking
Maybe that could be the reason
That the shitty poets heart is cold
Listen to me
Swipas round the globe a catch a flame
Imma run my mouth, yeah imma rap it’s ok

title: Talk To Me
content:
When the mouth runs, yeah the brain is thinking many different things
And “I love you”, tends to begin the ending of everything
Sometimes I just like the quiet
Sometimes I just like the cold
Cuz dramatic up and downs is why my soul is feeling old
If you feel sumn, let the vibes talk, you don’t really need to speak
Don’t you get that microphones mean you’re not just talking to me?

title: Myself
content:
Do I believe in myself?
Somebody taught me not to lean on myself
That everything I do is wrong I shouldn’t be in my self
It’s funny, who else am I really gonna be but myself
Except a character that only show a piece of myself
For real?
I tried to hide how I was being myself
Was scared the world was gonna judge me for the me in myself
Was scared that nobody would love me just for me by myself
I tend to overthink and critically demean on myself
There is a reason I’m a shitty poet, that is myself
The real me, someone who don’t gotta be someone else
I hope you find you
I don’t like being by myself
But I can’t have friends playing characters, just be yourself

title: Marie Antoinette
content:
And it’s crazy how my muse is turning Marie Antoinette
She want all the cake and she want eat it too cuz she the best
“They should all adore me, you know I’m a Queen, let me rest”
If you ask her about names, then she gonna fail the test
Let me splurge, let me ball, I don’t care, let em fall
And my happiness, is the most important thing of all
But this shitty poet here to tell you all about her fall
Yeah Marie she got the guillotine, the worst of em all

title: Ball Player
content:
Sometimes what I miss is my ball and my stick
I remember Nikes on my feet I was lit
Swinging for the fences I did not take no offense and
All I knew was grinding I ain’t wanna feel the benches
Wish it could come back yeah I wish I could adapt
I remember ball taught me patience how bout that
Patience turned me to a shitty poet I react
To nothing, but at strike 3 imma swing my big bat

title: View
content:
She try change my mind, I think she think she control my thoughts 
I don’t think at all, I’m just always fly I’m like a hawk
I can’t go too high, can’t let Icarus usurp my views
If I drop from heaven, down into the sea then it be blue
Don’t try hold my eyes, you do not know me just like I do
Don’t say don’t you see, it’s gonna make me just not like you
Maybe traumatized, you exposed me to things I’m ungrateful
At least you ain’t mix the good with the bad yeah I’m thankful 
Without my old swipa, swipe away the fake and all the crowd
I don’t think that this light inside of me ever would be found
Life almost made me lose my view you know adversity is hell…


Now this life I’m gone live well

title: Love
content:
Best kept thing that’s my award
The thing that I keep close this a shy award
What I don’t hand out on the fly award
Gotta pass my test what you vying for


It’s almost like a shitty poet
I need to do it for myself but I could never show it
I hope my friends could feel the parts that I be sending they way
And all my family I hope that you would reach your heyday
I love the process though it hurts even though it’s hard
Even though it really stings really kicks your rod
Appreciate the unneeded and not fake or pretend 
People who have sacrificed so much so I could live
The passes I’ve been given on mistakes that’s hard to bear
And everything just falling into place wish you was there
And everything around me working for me it appears
Though it may not be major they upload what now appears
And sometimes I just love that I could stop and ask for clear
Cuz silence to a swipa is like music to my ears

title: Circle
content:

content:
